item.title: Apple Releases New Polishing Cloth
item.description:
📝 Apple Releases New Polishing ClothTuesday August 25, 2026 6:50 am PDT by Joe RossignolApple today released a new version of its Polishing Cloth on its online store. We have yet to determine if the new Polishing Cloth is smaller than the original or has any other notable changes beyond lower pricing.
